description: Manifest of the cross-repository conformance corpus for euler-dataset-contract. Every path is relative to the directory holding this file. Enumerate the corpus from this manifest rather than by scanning directories, so that a consumer that cannot see a new fixture fails loudly instead of silently testing less.

covers_vocabulary.modality_key:unregistered: The head uses a modality.key with no registered meta fields.
covers_vocabulary.shared_meta:<field>: The head exercises this shared meta field.
covers_vocabulary.normalization:<rule>: Parsing rewrites the authored value; the canonical file records the result.
covers_vocabulary.section:<name>: The head populates this optional structural section.

inventory.name: euler-loading-modality-types
inventory.description: Vendored copy of the modality vocabulary euler-loading emits, used to detect drift against the shipped modality inventory.

evidence.name: tiny-five-field
evidence.description: Small independently calculated half-pixel bilinear resize followed by a shared center crop.

evidence.name: documented-five-field
evidence.description: The task's resize 384x768 then crop 320x640 example, with analytic interior pixel probes and known camera projection.

evidence.name: backend-resize
evidence.description: NumPy preprocessing changes backend when Torch is installed; Pillow and Torch also choose different nearest neighbors.

evidence.name: invalid-depth
evidence.description: Current ordinary bilinear depth resize blends invalid zero into otherwise valid metric depth.

evidence.name: pinhole-projections
evidence.description: Independent homogeneous-coordinate references for crop bounds and K_out = crop @ resize @ K_in; skew exposes a current loading defect.

evidence.name: depth-projection
evidence.description: Known metric planar depth unprojection to an organized XYZ map, distinct from sparse point-cloud representation.

evidence.name: hierarchy-selection
evidence.description: Current reduce=first sorts keys rather than proving sensor applicability; source calibration must not be mutated.

evidence.name: legacy-spatial-alignment
evidence.description: Shape-only evaluator decisions and their current sampling policies, recorded before lineage-aware alignment exists.

evidence.name: known-values
evidence.description: Raw encoded fixtures distinguish declared units, observed scaling, layouts, palette triplets, and cloud/map representations.

evidence.name: source-backed
evidence.description: Opaque heads and file attributes survive present writer APIs; a resized output currently inherits stale source dimensions.
